item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Hasina used emergency powers, security laws, surveillance, or administrative controls in a narrowly tailored and lawful way. I also did not find evidence of strong judicial review, independent oversight, or complaint mechanisms constraining those controls in 2024. The available record points much more clearly to coercion, shutdowns, and impunity than to lawful, limited emergency governance.","evidence":[{"title":"Bangladesh army enforces curfew as student-led protests spiral","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 20, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-army-enforces-curfew-as-student-led-protests-spiral/2182818/","summary":"Reuters reported a nationwide curfew and internet/text shutdown as the government escalated against protesters; this is direct evidence of emergency-like controls being used to intimidate opponents and suppress scrutiny.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.1","3B.2","2B.4","2B.6"]},{"title":"Bangladesh PM Hasina blames opposition for violence, curfew to remain","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 22, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-pm-hasina-blames-opposition-for-violence-curfew-to-remain-3528153","summary":"Hasina kept the curfew in place and blamed political opponents for the violence, which looks like coercive administrative control and collective blame rather than narrow lawful use.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.3","3B.1","2B.6","2B.7"]},{"title":"Bangladesh’s crackdown on protesters left more than 170 dead, U.N. says","publisher":"United Nations / OHCHR","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://bangladesh.un.org/en/275065-bangladesh-t%C3%BCrk-decries-government-crackdown-urges-respect-international-human-rights","summary":"The UN said more than 170 people had been killed and warned that internet shutdowns increase impunity; this strongly supports the view that the government used emergency controls as a coercive instrument, not a lawful, narrowly tailored one.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.1","3B.2","2B.4","2B.9"]},{"title":"Exclusive: Bangladesh army refused to suppress protest, sealing Hasina’s fate","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 6, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/exclusivebangladesh-army-refused-to-suppress-protest-sealing-hasinas-fate-3558302","summary":"Reuters reported the army would not fire on civilians to enforce Hasina’s curfew; that implies the coercive apparatus was being pushed toward lethal enforcement, not bounded legal necessity.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.1","3B.2","2B.4","2B.9"]},{"title":"Former Bangladesh PM Hasina demands probe into July \"killings and vandalism\"","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 13, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/former-bangladesh-pm-hasina-demands-probe-into-july-killings-and-vandalism/2222256/","summary":"After fleeing, Hasina called for an investigation into the killings and vandalism; this is the only weak accountability signal I found, but it is post-hoc and does not show that emergency powers were used lawfully while she controlled them.","question_ids":["3B.5","2B.9"]},{"title":"Bangladesh will not let in any more Rohingya refugees: minister","publisher":"Reuters","date":"February 7, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-will-not-let-in-any-more-rohingya-refugees-minister/1958020/","summary":"Bangladesh framed refusing additional Rohingya as a security necessity; this is the closest 2024 defensive-administration evidence I found, but it is indirect, voiced by a minister, and not evidence of narrowly lawful emergency powers by Hasina herself.","question_ids":["3B.5","2B.3"]},{"title":"Bangladesh ramps up border vigilance as thousands of Rohingya flee Myanmar","publisher":"Reuters","date":"September 11, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-ramps-up-border-vigilance-as-thousands-of-rohingya-flee-myanmar/2262488/","summary":"Bangladesh tightened border vigilance amid renewed violence in Myanmar and refugee flows; this is a defensive administrative control in response to external instability, but it does not show rights-respecting emergency governance inside Bangladesh.","question_ids":["3B.5","2B.3"]}]}
